name: propfirmvs-prop-firm-rules
title: Prop firm rules & prices dataset
description: Verified evaluation prices, profit targets, drawdown limits and rules of prop trading firms, one row per firm, product and account size.

fields.name: firm
fields.description: Firm name

fields.name: market
fields.description: futures, forex, crypto or stocks

fields.name: program
fields.description: Product / program name when a firm sells several (may be empty)

fields.name: account_size_usd
fields.description: Nominal account size in USD

fields.name: eval_price_usd
fields.description: Evaluation price in USD (one-time, or per month where the firm bills monthly)

fields.name: profit_target_usd
fields.description: Profit target in USD

fields.name: max_drawdown_usd
fields.description: Maximum drawdown in USD

fields.name: daily_loss_limit_usd
fields.description: Daily loss limit in USD; empty = none or unverified

fields.name: drawdown_type
fields.description: Static balance, Trailing end-of-day or Trailing intraday

fields.name: consistency_percent
fields.description: Consistency rule threshold in percent; empty = none or unverified

fields.name: activation_fee_usd
fields.description: Activation / funded-account fee in USD; empty = none or unverified

fields.name: challenge_steps
fields.description: Number of evaluation phases: 0 = instant funding, 1, 2 or 3

fields.name: time_limit_days
fields.description: Evaluation time limit in calendar days; 0 = no time limit; empty = unverified

fields.name: phase2_profit_target_usd
fields.description: Phase 2 profit target in USD (2+ step programs only)

fields.name: max_micro_contracts
fields.description: Maximum micro contracts allowed on this account size (futures); empty = not stated

fields.name: funded_drawdown_type
fields.description: Drawdown type of the funded phase when it differs from the evaluation

fields.name: funded_consistency_percent
fields.description: Consistency threshold for the funded/payout phase in percent; 0 = none; empty = unknown or same as evaluation

fields.name: price_per_1k_account_usd
fields.description: Derived: evaluation price per $1,000 of account size

fields.name: profit_target_to_drawdown
fields.description: Derived: profit target divided by max drawdown (lower = easier; 0 = no target)

fields.name: rule_strictness
fields.description: Derived: Lenient, Moderate, Strict or Very strict; transparent point count, see https://propfirmvs.com/methodology#derived

fields.name: hedging
fields.description: yes, restricted or no; empty = unverified

fields.name: copy_trading
fields.description: yes, restricted or no; empty = unverified

fields.name: scalping
fields.description: yes, restricted or no; empty = unverified

fields.name: martingale
fields.description: yes, restricted or no; empty = unverified

fields.name: stop_loss_required
fields.description: yes or no; empty = unverified

fields.name: min_trade_duration_sec
fields.description: Minimum trade duration in seconds; 0 = none; empty = unverified

fields.name: inactivity_days
fields.description: Days without a trade before the account may be closed; empty = unverified

fields.name: max_risk_per_trade_pct
fields.description: Maximum risk per trade as % of balance; empty = no such rule or unverified

fields.name: fee_refund
fields.description: Is the evaluation fee refunded (usually with the first payout): yes, partial or no

fields.name: first_payout_days
fields.description: Earliest day count from funded start to first payout request (calendar vs trading days differ per firm)

fields.name: min_payout_usd
fields.description: Minimum payout request in USD

fields.name: max_payout_usd
fields.description: Maximum per payout request in USD; empty = no cap stated

fields.name: payout_methods
fields.description: Payout methods, comma-separated: bank_wire, crypto, paypal, rise, wise, card, other

fields.name: funded_monthly_fee_usd
fields.description: Recurring fee after funding in USD; 0 = none; empty = unverified

fields.name: data_provider
fields.description: Futures data feed provider; empty = not stated

fields.name: leverage
fields.description: Leverage by asset class (forex/CFD/crypto)

fields.name: commissions
fields.description: Commissions / fees (forex/CFD/crypto)

fields.name: swap_free
fields.description: Swap-free account: yes, addon or no

fields.name: restricted_countries
fields.description: Countries whose residents cannot join, as published by the firm; empty = not found

fields.name: firm_page
fields.description: URL of the firm's review page on propfirmvs.com

fields.name: last_verified
fields.description: Date the firm rules were last checked against its own pages (YYYY-MM-DD)

fields.name: eval_billing
fields.description: one_time or monthly (evaluation billed as a subscription)

fields.name: price_per_1k_drawdown_usd
fields.description: Derived: evaluation list price per $1,000 of max drawdown

fields.name: cost_to_get_funded_usd
fields.description: Derived: evaluation list price (x 2 months if billed monthly) + activation fee; empty when the activation fee is unknown

fields.name: reset_fee_usd
fields.description: Reset fee for this product and size in USD

fields.name: funded_start_contracts
fields.description: Futures: contracts allowed at the start of the funded account

fields.name: payout_cap_usd
fields.description: Cap on the first payout(s) for this size in USD

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Pricing currency when the firm does not price in USD (EUR or GBP); empty = USD

fields.name: native_price
fields.description: Price in the firm's own currency; eval_price_usd is then an approximate USD conversion (ECB reference rate)

fields.name: dll_breach
fields.description: soft (trading paused for the day) or hard (account fails); empty = unverified

fields.name: dll_basis
fields.description: What the daily loss is measured from: balance, equity, higher_of, eod_balance, other

fields.name: dd_lock_trigger
fields.description: When the trailing drawdown stops trailing: none, balance_threshold, target_reached, first_payout

fields.name: dd_lock_offset_usd
fields.description: Drawdown floor locks at start balance + this amount (USD, main program)

fields.name: news_window_eval_min
fields.description: Minutes around high-impact news with restricted trading in the evaluation; 0 = no restriction

fields.name: news_window_funded_min
fields.description: Same for funded accounts; 0 = no restriction

fields.name: consistency_base
fields.description: What the consistency % is measured against: total_profit, profit_target, positive_days, other

fields.name: consistency_effect
fields.description: What breaking it does: blocks_payout, raises_target, fails_account, other

fields.name: commission_rt_es_usd
fields.description: Futures: round-turn commission per ES contract in USD

fields.name: data_feeds
fields.description: Futures data/connection feeds (Rithmic, Tradovate, CQG, ...)

fields.name: max_payouts
fields.description: Maximum number of payouts before the account closes or moves live; 0 = unlimited

fields.name: funded_account_type
fields.description: simulated, live or mixed (per the firm's terms)
